title: Chapter 80 Qinglong Sword Vs Long Axe
content:
Chapter 80 Qinglong Sword Vs Long Axe

At this time, everyone showed a solemn look.

Wang Shuo was even more worried about whether Ayub could take the opponent's most terrifying first blow.

Doliku used a long axe. This kind of weapon has a very strong first blow.

Of course, the consumption of physical strength is also very fast.

Therefore, Wang Shuo made up his mind to consume the opponent's wave first.

The opponent's attack power is 270 points. At present, it is impossible to kill one of his own people with one knife. As long as he is not hit in the vital parts and causes serious injuries, it will be considered a profit.

The rumbling sound of horse hooves was stirring on the grassland. Ayub and Doliku, like two trains, drove towards each other quickly, both of them with an indomitable momentum.

"Clang..."

The Qinglong sword and the long axe collided in the air, and the huge impact force almost shook the two people to the point of losing their weapons.

However, Doliku was still a step ahead, because he did not lose blood, while Ayub lost 10 points.

Then, the other members of the cavalry squad, each with a weapon, attacked Doliku.

This was not the time for a one-on-one duel.

Gong Zheng crossed his bronze hammers above his head and blocked Doliku's powerful vertical chop.

Wang Shuo seized the opportunity and stabbed his chest with his spear.

"Dragon attack."

After a short period of charging, a dragon-shaped spear force hit his chest directly.

"-1"

"What?"

"I only did this little damage with my ultimate move?"

After passing by, Wang Shuo quickly checked the battle log.

"The opponent used the skill 'Iron Wall' to defend against your 'Dragon Strike'."

After a long time, it turned out that this guy used a defensive skill.

Wang Shuo felt that this wave was a bit of a loss!

In the first confrontation, the opponent was one against ten.

The three main outputs of his side only caused 1 point of damage to the opponent.

The combat power of the generals was so terrifying!

Looking back, Wang Shuo found that Baili Liang and others behind him still found an opportunity to attack, causing him nearly 100 points of damage.

Finally, he regained some face.

"Ah!"

The injured Doliku roared and said angrily: "A bunch of idiots! Take another axe from grandpa."

As he said that, he jumped on his horse again.

The second round of confrontation between the two sides began.

With the experience of the first time, both sides adjusted their tactics.

Doliku used blocking moves for the attacks of Ayub and Gong Zheng, and focused on attacking Wang Shuo.

When the long axe came, Wang Shuo deeply felt the power of the general!

The flaming gun was chopped and rotated 360 degrees in the air.

If his horsemanship had not been upgraded to level 2, this collision would have directly knocked him off his horse.

Even though he defended the vital points, Wang Shuo was also seriously injured. He was directly beaten to vomit blood and lost 200 health points.

Doliku was not feeling well either. The cavalry squad and the others all caused him damage.

His body was covered with wounds, and his armor was stained red!

No matter who he targeted, others could effectively hurt him.

This was a typical wolf pack tactic.

Doriku, who was confident and arrogant, could not resist the opponent's shameless tactics alone.

He shouted to his remaining men: "What are you still looking at? Tear them apart!"

Dongfang Ling, who was surrounded, was very happy to see Wang Shuo and others fighting the bandit leader.

"Hey, stinky boy, are you here to save me?"

Because the distance was a bit far.

Wang Shuo heard it as "Hey, stinky boy, are you a funny guy hired by the monkey?"
